PLAN "12-Week Upper-Body Focused Programme for Subacromial Impingement (Pain-Free Range Only)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Upper-body strength with pain-free range for subacromial impingement"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Assessment and Foundation":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Trunk and Scapular Stability":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          trap_shrug 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 50m "Grip, Core, Posture":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          arnold_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          skull_crusher 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30 seconds rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Progression and Pain-Free Load Increase":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Stability and Mobility":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation_cable 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          serratus_p anterior_cable_target 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x30 seconds each side
        cooldown:
          thoracic_extension 60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 55m "Grip, Core, and Mild Loading":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 4x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Strength Emphasis with Pain-Free Range":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_fly 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Mobility and Scapular Control":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation_cable 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          serratus_pushups (on wall/bench) 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 each side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Endurance and Stability":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row 4x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown (within pain-free range) 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x30 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_release 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Peak Upper-Body in Pain-Free Range":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 5x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Mobility and Recovery Focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          external_rotation_cable 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 each side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Maintenance and Technique":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 60 seconds

END PLAN
